items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jules Buffano as having a band on another boat; the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or interaction.

ctx.x: Now, he would have had one of the best, I mean, bands around on that boat.
Yes, I think so, yeah. He was a real great band, see, because they had that fine band, Jules Buffano. He was on the other boat, the J.S., which was --
